name: Protopasta Flexible TPU
filament_notes:
Clear Flexible TPU, about 98A; also covers Recycled Black Flexible TPU.
Product page: start printing at 240C, no bed heat needed; prep the bed with Magigoo to avoid a permanent bond; drying overnight recommended. This profile sets no values of its own and inherits Orca's Generic TPU values (240C nozzle, 35C bed, 3.2 mm3/s cap). Direct-drive extruders, slow speeds and short retraction work best for flexible TPU.
